questions.text: Do you work, or are you a student?
questions.say: Good afternoon. My name is Alice, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about what you do. Do you work, or are you a student?

cueCard.topic: Describe a foreign language you would like to learn.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you would like to learn this language.

questions.text: Describe a foreign language you would like to learn.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a foreign language you would like to learn. You should say: which language it is; where it is spoken; how you would learn it; and explain why you would like to learn this language.

questions.text: Do you know anyone who speaks this language?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you know anyone who speaks this language?

questions.text: At what age should children start learning a foreign language?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a foreign language you would like to learn, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all learning languages. At what age should children start learning a foreign language?

questions.text: Why do some people find it easier to learn languages than others?
questions.say: Why do some people find it easier to learn languages than others?

questions.text: Is it better to learn a language at school or by living abroad?
questions.say: Is it better to learn a language at school or by living abroad?

questions.text: Why has English become an international language?
questions.say: Now let's talk about languages in the world. Why has English become an international language?

questions.text: Do you think one day everyone in the world will speak the same language?
questions.say: Do you think one day everyone in the world will speak the same language?

questions.text: What can be done to protect languages that are spoken by very few people?
